[[File:Reanimate Unicorn icon (mobile).png|left]]
'''Reanimate Unicorn''' was a [[reanimation spell]] that required a [[Magic]] level of 22 and an [[ensouled unicorn head]] to cast. The spell would summon a [[reanimated unicorn]] with 15 Hitpoints.

Upon killing the reanimated unicorn, players would gain 494 [[Prayer]] experience and 0.5% [[Arceuus]] [[favour]].

Reanimation could be cast on any ensouled head within an 31x31 area of where that head was dropped by a monster. This worked indefinitely, even if the ensouled head was picked up, so long as it was not put into the [[bank]], a [[trade]] screen, the [[Grand Exchange]], or the [[price checker]]. If the player had put it into any of those interfaces, the reanimation spell would only work within range of the [[Dark Altar]].
